name: Down the Scarlet Path
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
I will be frank.  We are at war with the Scourge.  It is an evil that corrupts our people and infects our land.  It must be stopped before it overwhelms us and drags our world into shadow.  We of the Scarlet Crusade have sworn to fight the Scourge with body and soul.

If you are with us, then gather your courage and prove your allegiance--destroy the undead ravagers of Desolace, in the Valley of Bones to the south.

Do this, and the Crusade will embrace you.
narrative.objectives: Destroy 30 Undead Ravagers, then return to Brother Anton at Nijel's Point.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You have proven your resolve, and the Scarlet Crusade commends you.

If you do not shy from righteous slaughter, then perhaps your path lies with us...
narrative.requestItemsText: The Scourge grows in power with the passing of each day. If you truly wish to halt its advances, then show me.

quests.name: In the Name of the Light
quests.objectiveText: Kill High Inquisitor Whitemane, Scarlet Commander Mograine, Herod, the Scarlet Champion and Houndmaster Loksey and then report back to Raleigh the Devout in Southshore.
